meta.title: Goods Receipt & Documentation
meta.flowPosition: after 10 Receiving Decision, before 12 Shift Report & Reflection
meta.note: Administrative stage. Backend-authoritative. Turns the Receiving Decision into net quantities, storage locations, and a formal Goods Receipt Note (GRN). Output is an immutable GRN record consumed by Screen 12.

purpose: The learner finalises the paperwork: confirms received quantities per PO line item after netting out quarantined and rejected quantities, assigns a warehouse storage location to each accepted item, and generates the Goods Receipt Note.
learningObjectives: Compute net accepted quantity per line item (PO qty minus quarantined/rejected qty)
Assign an appropriate storage location per accepted item
Generate a complete and accurate Goods Receipt Note
Verify the GRN against the Receiving Decision before submitting

input.note: Consumes the shipment decision plus the final quarantine/reject lists to compute what actually gets received into inventory.

locationLibrary.note: Storage bins/racks reused from the department object library (rack, bin); assignment is by area capacity, not a fixed mapping.

definitions.quantity_accuracy: confirmed net quantity per line item == PO qty minus quarantined/rejected qty for that line item
definitions.location_assignment_completeness: every accepted item has a storage location assigned
definitions.grn_accuracy: generated GRN's quantities and locations match what was confirmed/assigned in this session
definitions.conflict_handling: when a location is at capacity, did the learner resolve it (alternate location) rather than leaving it unassigned

assessmentRules.note: Completion and correctness remain separate. A learner may generate a GRN (complete) with an incorrect net quantity or an unassigned location (low correctness).

completion.rule: Stage completes when quantities are confirmed, locations assigned, the GRN is generated, and documentation is submitted.
completion.note: Completion = documentation submitted. Quantity/location accuracy is assessed separately via assessmentRules.

output.note: The GRN record becomes an immutable part of the simulation attempt and the system of record for what entered inventory.

shape.evidenceRef: LearnerAction seq range for this stage
